summary: Genvor Inc filed an 8-K reporting a side letter agreement with Evergreen Capital Management LLC modifying a previously disclosed securities purchase agreement. The amendment adjusts convertible note terms, increases warrant coverage from 600,000 to 1,200,000 shares, and accelerates funding of certain tranches, resulting in $333,334 gross proceeds. This is a routine financing amendment with no change of control, premium, or special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural special-situation mechanics are present. This filing does not trigger a special-situations category; it is an ordinary equity-linked financing arrangement.
